homebase.title: Founder in the Wild
homebase.description: How do you respond when things get real? Play through typical founder situations and compare what matters to each of you.

entry.title: When things get real
entry.intro: Five typical situations from founder life. You each decide independently how you would respond – then see what mattered to each of you and what you need from one another.
entry.twoFounders: Founder in the Wild V1 is available for teams with exactly two founders.
entry.changed: The round could not be started. Please reload the page.
entry.discarded: The round was discarded. You can start again later.
entry.declined: The round was ended. You can start again later.

round.back: Back to Founder in the Wild
round.introTitle: There is no right answer here.
round.introBody: You receive the same founder situations and decide independently how you would respond. Afterwards, you see what mattered to each of you and what you need from one another.
round.introReflection: What matters is not whether your answers are the same, but what you learn from them for your collaboration.
round.need: What do you need from your co-founder in this situation?
round.warning: You cannot change these answers after locking them.
round.waitingText: Your answers are locked. Now it is {name}'s turn.
round.waitingPrivacy: Your answers remain hidden until both of you have answered all five situations.
round.revealText: You have both answered every situation. Now you can reveal your answers one situation at a time.
round.discardConfirm: Answers locked in this round so far will be deleted. You can then start the pack again.
round.declineConfirm: The round will end and answers locked in it so far will be deleted.
round.invalid: Choose one move, one or two things that matter, and exactly one need.
round.changed: The round has changed. Please try again.

reveal.back: Back to Founder in the Wild
reveal.title: Reveal together
reveal.intro: Open each situation deliberately. The answers remain hidden until you reveal them.
reveal.talk1: What about the other person's response would help you?
reveal.talk2: What might irritate you about it?
reveal.talk3: What would you like to expect from each other in a similar situation?
reveal.mark: I want to talk about this
reveal.visible: This conversation point is visible to both of you.
reveal.debriefIntro: In these five situations, you had {same} same and {different} different first impulses.
